title: feat(l1horizon): L1 horizon equals the l1 diameter
science: Bounded_theorem note, no probe cell. HORIZON = DIAMETER: the farthest vertex (2,1,1) is at l1 distance 4, the patch is not full at tick 3 (11 of 12) and is full at tick 4, so the first saturating tick equals the diameter and the causal front travels at speed exactly 1 through the whole complex. TWO DEFECTS: (a) the quantity called 'diameter' is computed as max over v of d(v, seed), which is the ECCENTRICITY from the seed, not the graph diameter -- the two happen to coincide at 4 here, so the conclusion survives, but the definition in both note and runner is wrong; (b) the check 'first-saturating-tick-equals-diameter' is literally 4 == diam with 4 hard-coded, so the saturating tick is never derived from the computed history. 24/24 runner PASS.
